mapper.select: SELECT TA.SEQ, TA.NAME, TA.SORTING FROM TB_AUTH TA WHERE 1 = 1 AND TA.DELETED = 0 ORDER BY TA.SORTING ASC

SELECT TM.SEQ , TM.NAME , TM.PARENT_SEQ , TM.URL , TM.MATCH_URL , TM.`DEPTH` , TM.SORTING , TAM.SEQ_AUTH, IF(TAM.SEQ_AUTH IS NULL, 0, 1) AS CHECKED FROM TB_MENU TM LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_AUTH_MENU TAM ON TAM.SEQ_AUTH = #{authSeq} AND TAM.SEQ_MENU = TM.SEQ WHERE 1 = 1 AND TM.DELETED = 0
AND TM.PARENT_SEQ = #{menuSeq}
AND TM.PARENT_SEQ IS NULL
ORDER BY TM.SORTING
